blind.description: A stylized wooden armorer's workbench with a lower storage shelf and reinforced metal brackets on the legs. The top surface holds a pile of chainmail, a steel chestplate with gold trim, a miniature table anvil, a hammer, blacksmith tongs, and a small bowl filled with golden rivets. The lower shelf holds a steel helmet with gold trim and a folded leather armor roll with straps.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden plank tabletop featuring a clump of chainmail on the left, a curved breastplate in the center, and on the right a small anvil, a bowl of small brass rivets, metal pliers, and a hammer.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and around 4.5 ft long.
